title: Comfortable
text: Comfortable. This is comfortable to stand on for a long time.  It looks nice.  It has a vinyl top, but it's textured a bit and looks like fabric.  Easy to clean.  I only gave it 4 stars because I do have a anti-fatigue mat that is a little thicker.

product_metadata.title: Take Ten Comfort Kitchen Anti-Fatigue Mat, 20"x30", Light Grey
features: Anti-Fatigue technology: this home and office Comfort Mat can effectively prevent discomfort caused by standing for a long period of time.
Eco-friendly: the Take Ten Comfort Mat has no toxic off-gassing smell.
Safe: the Mat features a non-slip backing and a high-traction surface, providing maximum stability and support.
All-purpose Comfort: this modern anti-fatigue Comfort floor Mat is ideal for anywhere you stand - kitchen, laundry room, bathroom, garage, standing desk, or craft room.
Easy to clean: the Mat surface is stain-resistant, water-resistant and easy to wipe clean - perfect for the messy chef!
description: Take ten premium kitchen Comfort Mat provides superior cushioning and stylish designs at an affordable price. The Mat features a 1/2" Bounce-back foam which reduces pressure on your feet, knees, joints and lower back while standing.  The beveled edges provide a safe surface for those standing for long hours. The top surface Comes in a variety of styles which are all stain-resistant and easy to clean making this an ideal standing option for any room - kitchen, laundry Room, Garage, standing desk, craft room.
